paragraphs: "It's okay. We'll make even more money in the future. Look, this city has been revitalized. Just now, 500 restaurants received orders. This is just the first wave, and there will be more orders to come. After tonight, as soon as the data is released, other cities will soon be under our control." Xie Mei was unconvinced. She knew Zhao An had a lot of money—real money, not virtual money.

The capital for burning money comes from one's own money, and it must be real money. Otherwise, this trick won't work. The infinite nesting doll method may be able to make a fortune out of nothing, but if something goes wrong, it will be a disaster.

Next to her was a woman smoking. Compared to Qian Yuling's assertiveness, her temperament had a touch of seductive charm, and she was the kind of woman who was obviously calculating and not to be trifled with.

This was a first for both mother and daughter, sharing a husband. But for Zhao An, it wasn't the same. The first mother-daughter duo was the class beauty. He'd used money to coerce them into becoming his sex slaves. Both mother and daughter were pregnant, a fact that filled a man with excitement and pride at the mere thought.

"Mom, you make it sound like you're no longer a woman of the Zhao family," Huang Lin said coquettishly, her tone a mix of coquettishness and joking. She knew about her mother's relationship with Zhao An.

"I know, I'm just a little uncomfortable. This time, the money burned is really too much. It's different from building a community." Huang Lin sighed. She still agreed with the concept of building a community that was her own. After all, having your own home, surrounded by your own people, is a much better feeling.

And the fight for the position of heir was absolutely indispensable, requiring the help of a woman. If she were willing to help Tang Bing, a reversal would likely happen quickly. This wasn't just a pipe dream. The elders' words carried weight, but her grandmother's were even more powerful. As long as her grandmother lived, she would still hold considerable influence. However, compared to Qian Yuling's prominent presence, she was a reclusive woman who lived behind the scenes. Who could have imagined that a wealthy woman who lived in seclusion, toying with and beating men in the club every day, could actually carry such weight?

In another building, the power supply to the Tang Group branch had just been restored. It had been caused by an unnoticeable spot that hadn't been checked, and the wiring layout had been a bit messed up. Add to that the excessive power, and naturally, there were problems.

As if a thought had struck him, Tang Wu instructed the logistics manager to get the building back online as soon as possible. They were just barely keeping things going with diesel generators, and that wasn't a long-term solution.
In a villa, Qian Yuling and a pair of sisters were also watching TV, but the program on TV was just the opening concert hosted by Zhao An.
From mistress to mistress, even though they weren't married or registered, Huang Lin had already placed her heart entirely on Zhao An.

Tang Yuanxiu puffed on her cigarette, her beautiful eyes narrowed slightly. She had never been very involved in matters, but that didn't mean her words carried no weight. She was passionate about managing interpersonal relationships. As a direct descendant of the Tang family, she was familiar with the heads of many company branches, making it easier for her to communicate with them.

Looking at the live streaming platform's traffic, it was at its lowest today. Even the celebrities' live streams didn't have much. This time, the traffic had been completely drained away, and there was nothing he could do. After all, the other party's show was so much more exciting.

"Damn it! What's that Tang Bing doing? Damn it! Is he completely sealed off? Even if he's completely sealed off, I'm going to find out. If you can't, you're screwed!" Tang Wu roared angrily into the phone, hanging up before lighting a cigarette. He was irritated. Lately, Tang Bing's affairs had been a bit irritating. His big brother was showing signs of a comeback, which gave him a slight sense of crisis.
This was the complex secret of a large family, a mystery forever unknown, a mystery forever elusive.
It was his own fault. Why was he putting on airs when things were going well? Zhao An wouldn't fall for it. Putting on airs with him? Then he'd lose everything!

Huang Lin herself hadn't noticed that she could express such sentiments, but she was already putting herself in the position of a wife. She was thinking from the perspective of the mistress of the family, considering the benefits of such things for her family.
Xie Mei simply smiled at her daughter without saying anything, a touch of emotion still welling up in her heart.

That was the explanation, but Tang Wu wouldn't admit it. His mother had completely given him power, and even the family elders supported him. If he still couldn't defeat Zhao An and Tang Bing found an opportunity to turn the tables, he'd go crazy!
Qian Yuling still folded her stockinged legs, her delicate hands resting on the back of the sofa, a burning cigarette between her fingers, taking a puff from time to time to relieve her loneliness.

"Haha, that's good too. This way, I don't have to be sad to see you leave and get married." Xie Mei's smile was filled with happiness. As a beautiful, mature woman with intelligence and elegance, she was quite open-minded about this kind of relationship.

Xie Mei stroked her daughter's hair and said with a heartfelt smile, "No, it's just that I feel like you're married now. You're a woman of the Zhao family, having gone from a girl to a woman, truly grown up."
"Gosh awful!" Tang Wu spat, his eyes etched with indignation. He had considered collaborating with Zhao An before, but he'd been ridiculed when he'd called.

The logistics manager was someone Qian Yuling had promoted, and he was also someone Tang Wu was close to. So, despite all this, Tang Wu still didn't tear him off and take advantage of the situation to replace him with his own men.
Huang Lin felt a little embarrassed by her mother's gaze and said coyly, "Mom, what are you doing? Why do I feel like you're laughing at me?"

Compared to the smoky clouds of Qian Yuling and Tang Yuanxiu, Tang Wenxiu, sitting quietly sipping tea, looked rather delicate and charming. A hint of rosy glow clung to her pretty face, a rosy complexion compared to her former pallor, now tinged with color, making her look much more beautiful. This was how a woman should look. Nourished by semen, she blossomed with beauty, exuding an alluring, mature aura. At the prime of life, show the beauty of your youth.

paragraphs: Ding Dong! The doorbell rang. Qian Yuling picked up her phone and glanced at it, quickly catching sight of the scene outside. "It's Tang Wu, sister-in-law, please open the door for me."

Tang Wenxiu didn't refuse. It was a small matter. Besides, she felt a bit embarrassed that Qian Yuling had caught her in adultery with Zhao An. He was a married man, after all. A bad relationship was fine, everyone was the same, but cheating on her was a bit unacceptable.

"Mom, I'm planning to replicate what Future Group is doing. If they can do food delivery, we can too. From the live streaming platform, nothing is impossible to replicate. I'm going to spend a few days observing their approach. I know they know there's money to be made in this business, and it's doing so at a rapid clip. With a city-wide rollout, collecting merchant fees and taking a few yuan per order, we could make hundreds of thousands in profit a day. Monthly profits surpass the current net income of other industries!" Tang Wu said respectfully, his head bowed.

"Tsk, I'm not afraid. Someone who only relies on underhanded tactics is destined to achieve nothing. He doesn't even dare to stand up openly. What else do you expect him to do?" Tang Yuanxiu was not afraid at all. Let her accompany another man? For her to say such a thing, the Tang family must be on the verge of collapse. Otherwise, as long as the Tang family existed, she would always be that noble lady.

A truly accomplished man should remain calm and composed at all times. Furthermore, this kind of plagiarism and copying lacks any innovation. While it certainly makes money, that's all there is to it.
After opening the door, Tang Wu was stunned by the sight of Tang Wenxiu, who was stunned for a moment because he had personally ordered her dismissal. "Aunt."

Qian Yuling picked up her wine glass and said calmly, "Tang Wu is no ordinary person. He has deep connections with those old guys and often sends women to play with them. Humph, you really think I don't know. You just rejected him, be careful of his little tricks."
"Yes, Mother," Tang Wu nodded and bowed.
Qian Yuling didn't react when she saw her son come in. She continued to sit on the sofa, smoking a cigarette. "Speak."

"I'm not capable of helping you. Find someone else. I'm just sitting around. Um, I'm really feeling sleepy. Yuling, would you like a drink? Sister, bring some wine over. The three of us should have a nice drink. This kind of leisurely life is what women deserve." Tang Yuanxiu flatly rejected Tang Wu. She could see that Tang Wu was incapable of achieving anything.
Her tone was efficient and neat. Even though she no longer held a position within the group, she still exuded a powerful aura.
Looking at his aunt, who was watching TV with a smile nearby, he couldn't help but say she had a wonderful figure. It was such a waste to let those prostitutes play with her!
"Yuling, is Xiaoyin's marriage to Shanxing Group irreversible?" Tang Wenxiu asked silently. She still valued her niece, Tang Yin. At least among relatives, their relationship was already very good.

Tang Wenxiu had been a bit worried. Her feelings for Zhao An were complicated. She couldn't say she hated him, nor did she like him. But if he wanted to have sex with her, she probably wouldn't refuse, nor would she resist. She was only worried about Qian Yuling's attitude. So far, she seemed quite calm and didn't say anything. We're all adults now, so we just need to be more open-minded about some things.

"Yeah." Tang Wenxiu simply said hello and turned to leave. She had no fondness for her nephew, Tang Wu, beyond personal grudges. Tang Wu's struggle with Zhao An also resented her somewhat. While she couldn't say she would help Zhao An against Tang Wu's family, it was unrealistic to ask her to help Tang Wu.
"Aunt, I need your help with something," Tang Wu said, turning to Tang Yuanxiu and smiling.

Going to the club to find prostitutes was just playing with the body. It was just to get what they wanted, just for fun. Cheating, on the other hand, was a matter of the heart. It wasn't just about the heart, it was about the body. Some people were conquered by someone, both physically and mentally, which was a bit too much.

If Tang Wu knew how his aunt, Tang Yuanxiu, played with prostitutes, he probably wouldn't say it was a waste. He'd just say it was just bad luck for the prostitutes. To be played with by such a wealthy woman was simply the worst possible luck!

In terms of raising her children, she basically adopted a hands-off approach, letting them follow their personalities. This was the same for both men and women; just because women didn't have inheritance rights didn't mean they were useless.
After leaving the villa, Tang Wu realized his back was already wet. Facing Qian Yuling, the oppressive feeling made him feel a little uncomfortable.

"If you want to do it, do it. You're the head of the family, appointed by the elders. There's no point in telling me. Find a way on your own. If you want to do something, go find the person in charge. You're grown up now. Stop coming to me like a child starving." Qian Yuling refused without a second thought. Wanting her help? This was basically asking her to work for them. What a joke! Qian Yuling would either refuse to do it or become the boss. She absolutely wouldn't submit to anyone.
Neither Tang Wu nor Tang Bing dared to breathe when facing their mother, Qian Yuling. Her powerful aura was too overwhelming, not something a vase could imbue.

Tang Wu was a little annoyed. He wasn't stupid. He knew that Tang Yuanxiu, his aunt, had connections. Since she wasn't willing to help him, don't blame him for being rude. "Okay, I understand." With that, he left the villa in a rage. He didn't dare lose his temper. Getting angry with this beautiful elder would be tedious. And with his mother present, he didn't dare act rashly.

"She has to rely on herself for this kind of thing. I can definitely stop it if I intervene. But if I stop her this time, what about the next time? Women have to marry. As for the kind of person she chooses, that's up to her to work hard. I'm not a babysitter, I can't guarantee her a lifetime. If I don't put some pressure on her, she'll never know how to strive." Qian Yuling stated her plans.

"You're such a cunning woman, haha. Let's drink to us as women." Tang Yuanxiu smiled and picked up her glass. She didn't want to care about children, nor could she. She was better off just enjoying herself.
